title: Warm conversation and time to reflect
meaning: Lively interest helps you speak for the sake of closeness, while a pause afterwards can give what you heard a more personal meaning.
text: A warm conversation can continue inwardly long after its final sentence. The Empress in the physical position of Vishuddha makes speech generous: asking about details, developing suggestions and giving a story room to grow. The Lovers in energy support a wish to meet each other through words while preserving mutual involvement and freedom of response. The Hermit in emotions experiences what is heard through personal reflection. Closeness can appear in an animated exchange and also in a quiet moment when someone comes to understand what has opened up for them.

For example, during a walk you discuss an old promise to learn something together. One story prompts another, several possibilities emerge, and then silence arrives. **A pause can deepen conversation when the connection stays clear.** Later, a brief “I’m still thinking about what you said” shows that the subject remains present. The exchange has a continuation without requiring an immediate choice of activity or equal enthusiasm about every suggestion.

The difficulty comes if silence after a rich exchange becomes something the other person must decipher. Another question may seem necessary to restore mutuality while the reply still needs time to form. Caring participation can then crowd the other person’s reflection. A small sign of involvement helps distinguish thinking from disappearing out of the conversation, leaving both of you room for your own pace.
